summary: Pharvaris N.V. filed a Form 6-K on September 8, 2026, solely to furnish an investor presentation containing topline data from its CHAPTER-3 clinical trial. The filing includes no special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or management change; it merely provides forward-looking statements about ongoing development of deucrictibant. The registrant is a foreign private issuer reporting under cover of Form 6-K per SEC rules. The exhibit is not deemed filed under the Exchange Act. As a routine disclosure of clinical results and corporate information, it does not constitute a special situation.
